displayName: Recorded Future SCF - Weaponized Domains and URLs: Domains
note: Ingests weaponized domains from Recorded Future Fusion public prevent file weaponized_domains.json as Host indicators. Unchanged files are skipped via feed_hash; known rows are skipped via the UUID attribute. Batches are queued without waiting unless Log Batch Errors is on. A rejected upload still fails the job.

params.label: ThreatConnect Owner
params.name: tc_owner
params.note: The destination Owner in the ThreatConnect Platform.

params.label: Recorded Future API Token
params.name: rf_token
params.note: API token for Recorded Future Fusion file download (X-RFToken).

params.label: Feed Hash
params.name: feed_hash
params.note: Optional. Leave empty on first run. Map the previous job feed_hash output into this input; if the Fusion file is unchanged the job exits without UUID TQL or batch.

params.label: Log Batch Errors
params.name: log_batch_errors
params.note: When off, queue each batch and continue. The job still fails immediately if ThreatConnect rejects the upload. When on, wait for each batch to finish and log indicator errors.
